title: Logistics Priority Sorting
problem: High-latency sorting of incoming shipment manifests causes bottlenecks during peak delivery windows.
solution: Heapsort provides a reliable, in-place sorting mechanism by building a binary heap from the manifest data and repeatedly extracting the extremal element to organize shipments by priority.
steps: Transform the unordered shipment array into a max-heap structure to satisfy the heap property.
Swap the root element, representing the highest priority shipment, with the last element in the array.
Reduce the heap size and perform a heapify operation on the new root to restore the max-heap property.
Repeat the extraction and heapify process until the entire manifest is sorted in ascending order.
outcome: Consistent, predictable sorting performance that eliminates processing spikes during high-volume periods.
limitation: Heapsort is not a stable sort, meaning the relative order of shipments with identical priority values may not be preserved; verify this by checking if original input indices are maintained after sorting.
